title: Claude Code uses Bun written in Rust now
summary: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI tool has transitioned from using Bun (a JavaScript/TypeScript runtime written in Zig) to being rewritten in Rust, marking a significant technical shift for the popular AI coding assistant.
problem_solved: Addresses performance, binary size, and cross-platform reliability concerns by migrating from a higher-level runtime to a systems programming language.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how AI companies optimize their developer tools through lower-level implementations, providing insights into production-grade tooling decisions for the AI ecosystem.
